notes: The second attributive article τῷ before μαρτυροῦντι is unrepresented under rule 31, κυρίῳ being an expressed head noun, and who is the participle's helper.
The italicized there is marked added under rule 5, no token of the projection carrying a locative; folding it onto διέτριψαν is named in the unit's note as the competing reading.

παρρησιαζόμενοι → speaking boldly heads on speaking, which is the reading rule 91's precedent supports: βλασφημέω → speaking evil, καταλαλιάς → evil speakings and δυσφημίας → evil report all head the speech-core word. Heading on boldly as the παρρησ- gloss is the competing reading.
μέν is unrepresented under rule 70; a reference comparison will report it as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.
